title.narrative: Supporting the Judiciary System in the Enforcement of Environmental Legislation

description.narrative: The objective of this activity is to strengthen the capacity of the Ministry of Justice in enforcing environmental legislation. The activity will include 4 tasks: (1) To review existing cases of environmental jurisprudence per sector in Lebanoncomma compare them to international case studies and develop a reference guide for Judges; (2) To establish an environmental experts testimony database; (3) To introduce an environmental course at the Institute of Judicial Training at the Ministry of Justice; and (4) To raise awareness and ensure wide dissemination of information. 7/30/07.
